text: This report will recommend the Zoo modify the scope of the Energy Retrofit Project Phase II based on recommendations from the City of Toronto Energy and Environment Office. The modifications will result in significant greenhouse gas emissions reductions and align with the Toronto Zoo’s environmental and natural resources conservation platform and City of Toronto's TransformTO objectives.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved modifications to the heat pump and the associated costs to the Energy Retrofit Project Concept Design.
